race.name: Human
race.ability: Str 1, Dex 1, Con 1, Int 1, Wis 1, Cha 1

trait.name: Languages
trait.text: You can speak, read, and write Common and one extra language of your choice.

trait.name: Darkvision
trait.text: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

trait.name: Dwarven Resilience
trait.text: You have advantage on saving throws against poison, and you have resistance against poison damage.

trait.name: Dwarven Toughness
trait.text: Your hit point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 every time you gain a level.

trait.name: Darkvision
trait.text: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

trait.name: Fey Ancestry
trait.text: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put you to sleep.

class.name: Fighter
class.proficiency: Strength, Constitution, Acrobatics, Animal Handling, Athletics, History, Insight, Intimidation, Perception, Survival
class.armor: Light Armor, Medium Armor, Heavy Armor, Shields

feature.name: Fighting Style
feature.text: You adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty.

feature.name: Fighting Style: Defense
feature.text: While you are wearing armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC.

feature.name: Fighting Style: Dueling
feature.text: When you are wielding a melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls with that weapon.

feature.name: Second Wind
feature.text: On your turn, you can use a bonus action to regain hit points equal to 1d10 + your fighter level. Once you use this feature, you must finish a short or long rest before you can use it again.

feature.name: Action Surge
feature.text: On your turn, you can take one additional action. Once you use this feature, you must finish a short or long rest before you can use it again.

feature.name: Martial Archetype
feature.text: You choose an archetype that you strive to emulate in your combat styles and techniques.

feature.name: Martial Archetype: Champion
feature.text: The archetypal Champion focuses on the development of raw physical power honed to deadly perfection.

feature.name: Improved Critical (Champion)
feature.text: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

feature.name: Ability Score Improvement
feature.text: You can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. You can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

feature.name: Extra Attack
feature.text: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

class.name: Wizard
class.proficiency: Intelligence, Wisdom, Arcana, History, Insight, Investigation, Medicine, Religion
class.weapons: Daggers, Darts, Slings, Quarterstaffs, Light Crossbows

feature.name: Spellcasting
feature.text: Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for your wizard spells.

feature.name: Arcane Recovery
feature.text: Once per day when you finish a short rest, you can choose expended spell slots to recover with a combined level equal to or less than half your wizard level (rounded up).

feature.name: Arcane Tradition
feature.text: You choose an arcane tradition, shaping your practice of magic.

feature.name: Arcane Tradition: School of Evocation
feature.text: You focus your study on magic that creates powerful elemental effects.

feature.name: Evocation Savant (School of Evocation)
feature.text: The gold and time you must spend to copy an evocation spell into your spellbook is halved.

feature.name: Sculpt Spells (School of Evocation)
feature.text: When you cast an evocation spell that affects other creatures that you can see, you can choose a number of them equal to 1 + the spell's level to automatically succeed on their saving throws.

feature.name: Ability Score Improvement
feature.text: You can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1.

trait.name: Description
trait.text: You have spent your life in the service of a temple to a specific god or pantheon of gods.

trait.name: Feature: Shelter of the Faithful
trait.text: You and your adventuring companions can expect to receive free healing and care at a temple, shrine, or other established presence of your faith.

feat.name: Grappler
feat.text: You have advantage on attack rolls against a creature you are grappling. You can use your action to try to pin a creature grappled by you.

spell.name: Fire Bolt
spell.text: You hurl a mote of fire at a creature or object within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 fire damage.
This spell's damage increases by 1d10 when you reach 5th level (2d10), 11th level (3d10), and 17th level (4d10).

spell.name: Magic Missile
spell.text: You create three glowing darts of magical force. Each dart hits a creature of your choice that you can see within range and deals 1d4 + 1 force damage.

spell.name: Shield
spell.text: An invisible barrier of magical force appears and protects you. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC.

spell.name: Mage Armor
spell.components: V, S, M (a piece of cured leather)
spell.text: You touch a willing creature who isn't wearing armor. Until the spell ends, the target's base AC becomes 13 + its Dexterity modifier.

spell.name: Cure Wounds
spell.text: A creature you touch regains a number of hit points equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier.

spell.name: Fireball
spell.components: V, S, M (a tiny ball of bat guano and sulfur)
spell.text: Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within range must make a Dexterity saving throw. A target takes 8d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

item.name: Longsword, +1
item.text: You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

item.name: Potion of Healing
item.text: You regain 2d4 + 2 hit points when you drink this potion.

item.name: Ring of Protection
item.text: You gain a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws while wearing this ring.

trait.name: Nimble Escape
trait.text: The goblin can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

action.name: Scimitar
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

action.name: Shortbow
action.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
